title: The spatial locus of common tangents to three disjoint convex sets is null
strongest_verified_claim: For any three pairwise disjoint convex subsets of R^3, without closedness, boundedness, smoothness, nonempty-interior or nondegeneracy requirements, the spatial union of complete affine lines meeting each set and lying in a supporting plane for each has Lebesgue outer measure zero.
